mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_daily_price ( stock_id, trading_date, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, adjusted_close, volume, trading_value, market_cap ) VALUES ( #{stockId}, #{tradingDate}, #{openPrice}, #{highPrice}, #{lowPrice}, #{closePrice}, #{adjustedClose}, #{volume}, #{tradingValue}, #{marketCap} ) ON CONFLICT (stock_id, trading_date) DO UPDATE SET open_price = EXCLUDED.open_price, high_price = EXCLUDED.high_price, low_price = EXCLUDED.low_price, close_price = EXCLUDED.close_price, adjusted_close = EXCLUDED.adjusted_close, volume = EXCLUDED.volume, trading_value = EXCLUDED.trading_value, market_cap = EXCLUDED.market_cap, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stock_daily_price WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND trading_date = #{tradingDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_news ( stock_id, title, summary, original_url, source_url, source_name, published_at, sentiment, sentiment_score, content_hash ) VALUES ( #{stockId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{originalUrl}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceName}, #{publishedAt}, #{sentiment}, #{sentimentScore}, #{contentHash} ) ON CONFLICT (stock_id, content_hash) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, summary = EXCLUDED.summary, original_url = EXCLUDED.original_url, source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url, source_name = EXCLUDED.source_name, published_at = EXCLUDED.published_at, sentiment = EXCLUDED.sentiment, sentiment_score = EXCLUDED.sentiment_score, collected_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stock_news WHERE id = #{id} AND stock_id = #{stockId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_disclosure ( stock_id, receipt_number, report_name, submitter_name, event_type, detail_url, received_at, analyzed_summary ) VALUES ( #{stockId}, #{receiptNumber}, #{reportName}, #{submitterName}, #{eventType}, #{detailUrl}, #{receivedAt}, #{analyzedSummary} ) ON CONFLICT (receipt_number) DO UPDATE SET stock_id = EXCLUDED.stock_id, report_name = EXCLUDED.report_name, submitter_name = EXCLUDED.submitter_name, event_type = EXCLUDED.event_type, detail_url = EXCLUDED.detail_url, received_at = EXCLUDED.received_at, analyzed_summary = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.analyzed_summary, stock_disclosure.analyzed_summary), collected_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stock_disclosure WHERE id = #{id} AND stock_id = #{stockId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_financial ( stock_id, business_year, report_code, statement_type, revenue, operating_profit, net_income, total_assets, total_liabilities, total_equity, roe, debt_ratio, currency, source_updated_at ) VALUES ( #{stockId}, #{businessYear}, #{reportCode}, #{statementType}, #{revenue}, #{operatingProfit}, #{netIncome}, #{totalAssets}, #{totalLiabilities}, #{totalEquity}, #{roe}, #{debtRatio}, #{currency}, #{sourceUpdatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (stock_id, business_year, report_code, statement_type) DO UPDATE SET revenue = EXCLUDED.revenue, operating_profit = EXCLUDED.operating_profit, net_income = EXCLUDED.net_income, total_assets = EXCLUDED.total_assets, total_liabilities = EXCLUDED.total_liabilities, total_equity = EXCLUDED.total_equity, roe = EXCLUDED.roe, debt_ratio = EXCLUDED.debt_ratio, currency = EXCLUDED.currency, source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stock_financial WHERE id = #{id} AND stock_id = #{stockId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_id, report_date, report_type, report_key, report_status, overview_json::text AS overview_json, news_json::text AS news_json, disclosure_json::text AS disclosure_json, financial_json::text AS financial_json, risk_json::text AS risk_json, technical_json::text AS technical_json, one_line_summary, failure_message, model_name, prompt_version, data_as_of, generated_at, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_report WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND report_type = #{reportType} AND report_key = #{reportKey}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_report ( stock_id, report_date, report_type, report_key, report_status, overview_json, news_json, disclosure_json, financial_json, risk_json, technical_json, one_line_summary, failure_message, model_name, prompt_version, data_as_of, generated_at ) VALUES ( #{stockId}, #{reportDate}, #{reportType}, #{reportKey}, #{reportStatus}, CAST(#{overviewJson} AS JSONB), CAST(#{newsJson} AS JSONB), CAST(#{disclosureJson} AS JSONB), CAST(#{financialJson} AS JSONB), CAST(#{riskJson} AS JSONB), CAST(#{technicalJson} AS JSONB), #{oneLineSummary}, #{failureMessage}, #{modelName}, #{promptVersion}, #{dataAsOf}, #{generatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (stock_id, report_type, report_key) DO UPDATE SET report_date = EXCLUDED.report_date, report_status = EXCLUDED.report_status, overview_json = EXCLUDED.overview_json, news_json = EXCLUDED.news_json, disclosure_json = EXCLUDED.disclosure_json, financial_json = EXCLUDED.financial_json, risk_json = EXCLUDED.risk_json, technical_json = EXCLUDED.technical_json, one_line_summary = EXCLUDED.one_line_summary, failure_message = EXCLUDED.failure_message, model_name = EXCLUDED.model_name, prompt_version = EXCLUDED.prompt_version, data_as_of = EXCLUDED.data_as_of, generated_at = EXCLUDED.generated_at, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stock_report WHERE id = #{id} AND stock_id = #{stockId}
